recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7445 unless the clinical overview analogy is later rewritten wholesale.
issue_request: FHIR-7445 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for the FHIR-core overview clinical introduction. It asked that the REST file-cabinet analogy's read interaction say it returns the top piece of paper, i.e. the most recent/current version, rather than ambiguously getting a copy of a folder.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was made in svn revision 6511. The imported git commit 5e324fa4ca06ecbd4ad29e342be1dda60a0d8b1c has that svn revision in its git-svn-id and changed source/overview-clinical.html from "Get a copy of one a specific folder" to a top-piece/current-version read description. A later QA cleanup in c3c5f59e2d47f318df0abd2236c3ad28b2e95dd3 preserved the requested meaning and refined the sentence to the current wording.
additional_context: The current source still publishes source/overview-clinical.html through source/hierarchy.xml. The overview now says read returns "the top piece of paper (which is the most current version)" from the specific folder. The normative RESTful API page independently describes read as reading the current state and vread as reading a specific version, so no later source check contradicts the applied interpretation. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-7445 and the distinctive wording found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current built source already conveys the requested clarification in the target overview page and the relevant REST interaction definitions remain consistent.
